comment: Gates are the decisions that must be fixed before downstream work is worth doing. The plan mode refuses to leave one silently unset. This is the domain-specific half of an otherwise generic mode set.
label: The five frozen choices
rationale: Fix these before iterating. Changing one mid-stream makes results incomparable across attempts, so improvements stop being interpretable as stronger signal and become changed definitions.

items.name: Decision-time correctness
items.must_state: What is knowable at each decision point, and how every feature is aligned to its availability.

items.name: Tradability & universe
items.must_state: What can be traded, liquidity and capacity screens, shorting and borrow rules.

items.name: Label & horizon
items.must_state: The target and the holding period — this is what the model actually optimises.

items.name: Cost-model class
items.must_state: Which frictions apply: spread, slippage, financing, impact. The class is frozen; parameters get estimated.

items.name: Evaluation protocol
items.must_state: Walk-forward structure, holdout design, trial logging.

additional.name: Archetype
additional.must_state: Left-skew (mean reversion) or right-skew (trend following)? Determines the failure mode, the right risk metric, and whether stops even apply.

additional.name: Edge as a number
additional.must_state: Gain expectancy decomposed into win rate, average win, average loss — and which module you are attacking.
